entities.title: Hand of the Isle
entities.summary: An original god game made in Godot 4: the player reshapes an island and calls down powers so their followers outgrow a rival deity's. It runs in the browser at icelander.net/games/fresh/hand-of-the-isle/, for invited players only.
entities.purpose: godot/ is the game: one scene (main.tscn) runs Main, which builds everything else in code (the terrain, the simulation, the rival, the camera and the interface), with no external assets. web/ is the landing page and the play page's stylesheet and boot script, worker/ the Cloudflare Worker that serves every file only to signed-in holders of the invite-only role games:hand-of-the-isle, and build.mjs exports the game for the web. README.md gives the rules, the controls and the commands.
boundaries: The role games:hand-of-the-isle is declared in the icelander.net repository (accounts/src/config.js) and granted or sent as an invitation at icelander.net/private/admin; the login service checks it, not this folder.
There are no desktop builds, saved games or high scores, and the game makes no network requests of its own.
